purpose: Fixed translations for turning technical watershed recommendations into farmer-friendly English.

style_rules.reading_level: Use everyday English for a non-technical adult reader.
style_rules.sentence_length: Prefer sentences of 18 words or fewer.
rules: Preserve all warnings, uncertainty, directions, seasons, and numbers that materially affect a decision.
Do not promise changes to rainfall, temperature, humidity, wind, or crop yield.
Do not describe retrieved papers or the language model.
Do not show retrieval scores, model names, or internal gate scores.
When evidence is weak, say plainly that the farmer should not depend on that benefit.
Use a technical term only when no listed farmer-friendly wording can preserve its meaning.
